Let's make a band!
Piano, drum, guitar —
let's play, let's play!
🦝 Come on, friends!
I can play the piano!
Plink, plink, plink —
can you play it too?
🦝 Plink, plonk!
Can you play the drum?
Boom, boom, boom —
I can do it!
🐶 Boom, boom!
Can you play the guitar?
Strum, strum, strum —
I can do it!
🐰 Strum, strum!
I can play the trumpet!
Toot, toot, toot —
louder, louder!
🦝 TOOT!
TOOT — off flies my cap!
Toooot! The cap flies up —
ha, ha, ha!
🦝 Whoops!
What a band!
Speaky, Coco and Bella —
the best band of all!
🦝🐶🐰 Hooray!
